user_query: I want to surprise my sister with a gift. Can you search for perfumes on recash and retrieve all available products? Please include the names, prices, discounts, and start dates of the offers. Also, fetch the images of the perfumes to help me choose the best one.

TaskList.description: Search for perfumes on the recash platform and retrieve a list of all available products.
Retrieve detailed information for each perfume, including names, prices, discounts, and start dates of the offers.
Fetch images for each of the perfumes retrieved to aid in selection.
